title: A Modified BCA Method for Determination of Residual Protein in Enzymatic Biosynthetic Rebaudioside M
author: Li, Feng
materials: Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) Reference Stock Solution

Bovine serum albumin (BSA) (Solarbio Science & Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing; Batch 1229Z051, 98% purity); 2,2′‐biquinoline‐4,4′‐dicarboxylic acid disodium salt (Sigma‐Vetec); anhydrous sodium carbonate (Macklin Biochemical Co., Ltd., Shanghai); sodium tartrate (Sinopharm Chemical Reagent Co., Ltd.); sodium hydroxide (Sinopharm Chemical Reagent Co., Ltd.); sodium bicarbonate (Titan Scientific Co., Ltd., Shanghai); copper (II) sulfate pentahydrate (Sinopharm Chemical Reagent Co., Ltd.); sodium deoxycholate (Macklin Biochemical Co., Ltd., Shanghai); and trichloroacetic acid (Titan Scientific Co., Ltd., Shanghai). All chemicals were of analytical grade. Experimental procedures utilized ultrapure water (18.2 MΩ cm resistivity) generated by a Milli‐Q water purification system (Millipore Corporation, USA).

BSA Reference Working Solutions: Dilute aliquots of the BSA reference stock solution with the sodium hydroxide solution to obtain calibration standards at concentrations of 2, 2.5, 5, 7.5, and 10 mg/L.

Reb A Spiked Sample Solutions: Dissolve Reb M in the sodium hydroxide solution, then add defined volumes of the BSA reference stock solution to prepare mixtures containing 120 mg/mL Reb M and 2, 5, or 10 mg/L BSA.

Reb D Spiked Sample Solutions: Dissolve Reb M in the sodium hydroxide solution, then add defined volumes of the BSA reference stock solution to prepare mixtures containing 50 mg/mL Reb M and 2, 5, or 10 mg/L BSA.

Reb M Spiked Sample Solutions: Dissolve Reb M in the sodium hydroxide solution, then add defined volumes of the BSA reference stock solution to prepare mixtures containing 50 mg/mL Reb M and 2, 5, or 10 mg/L BSA.

steps.title: Gather chemicals and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all listed reagents (BSA, 2,2′‑biquinoline‑4,4′‑dicarboxylic acid disodium salt, anhydrous sodium carbonate, sodium tartrate, sodium hydroxide, sodium bicarbonate, copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate, sodium deoxycholate, trichloroacetic acid) and equipment (UV‑Vis spectrophotometer UV‑1900i, analytical balance, high‑speed centrifuge) using ultrapure water (18.2 MΩ cm).

steps.title: Prepare BCA Reagent A
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g 2,2′‑biquinoline‑4,4′‑dicarboxylic acid disodium salt, 2 g anhydrous sodium carbonate, 0.16 g sodium tartrate, 0.4 g sodium hydroxide, and 0.95 g sodium bicarbonate; dissolve in ultrapure water and adjust the volume to 100 mL; verify the solution pH is 11.2 ± 0.1.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % copper sulfate solution
steps.instruction: Weigh an appropriate amount of copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate to make a 4 % (w/v) aqueous solution in ultrapure water.

steps.title: Prepare BCA Reagent C
steps.instruction: Mix BCA Reagent A and B at a volumetric ratio of 50:1 (A:B) to obtain the working BCA solution; prepare fresh immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare sodium deoxycholate solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve sodium deoxycholate in ultrapure water to obtain a solution containing 15 mg per 10 mL (1.5 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Prepare TCA test solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 7.2 g trichloroacetic acid in 10 mL ultrapure water.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % sodium hydroxide solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 4 g sodium hydroxide in 100 mL ultrapure water to obtain a 4 % (w/v) solution.

steps.title: Prepare BSA stock solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.0 mg mL⁻¹ aqueous solution of BSA.

steps.title: Prepare BSA calibration standards
steps.instruction: Dilute aliquots of the BSA stock with the 4 % sodium hydroxide solution to obtain calibration standards of 2, 2.5, 5, 7.5, and 10 mg L⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare Reb A sample (120 mg mL⁻¹)
steps.instruction: Accurately weigh the required amount of Reb M, dissolve in the 4 % sodium hydroxide solution, and dilute to a final concentration of 120 mg mL⁻¹; prepare three independent replicates.

steps.title: Prepare Reb A spiked samples
steps.instruction: Dissolve Reb M as above, then add calculated volumes of the BSA stock solution to obtain mixtures containing 120 mg mL⁻¹ Reb M and 2, 5, or 10 mg L⁻¹ BSA.

steps.title: Prepare Reb D sample (50 mg mL⁻¹)
steps.instruction: Accurately weigh the required amount of Reb M, dissolve in the 4 % sodium hydroxide solution, and dilute to a final concentration of 50 mg mL⁻¹; prepare three independent replicates.

steps.title: Prepare Reb D spiked samples
steps.instruction: Dissolve Reb M as above, then add defined volumes of the BSA stock solution to obtain mixtures containing 50 mg mL⁻¹ Reb M and 2, 5, or 10 mg L⁻¹ BSA.

steps.title: Prepare Reb M sample (50 mg mL⁻¹)
steps.instruction: Accurately weigh the required amount of Reb M, dissolve in the 4 % sodium hydroxide solution, and dilute to a final concentration of 50 mg mL⁻¹; prepare three independent replicates.

steps.title: Prepare Reb M spiked samples
steps.instruction: Dissolve Reb M as above, then add defined volumes of the BSA stock solution to obtain mixtures containing 50 mg mL⁻¹ Reb M and 2, 5, or 10 mg L⁻¹ BSA.

steps.title: Prepare blank
steps.instruction: Use the 4 % sodium hydroxide solution as the blank control.

steps.title: Interference removal and BCA assay
steps.instruction: For each test or standard tube: add 1.0 mL sample, then 0.1 mL sodium deoxycholate solution, vortex, incubate at 25 °C for 10 min; add 0.3 mL TCA solution, vortex, centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 15 min; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1.0 mL sodium hydroxide solution, repeat vortex‑incubate‑centrifuge steps; add BCA Reagent C to the final pellet, incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, cool to ambient temperature, then measure absorbance at 562 nm. Use a stopwatch to keep 60‑second intervals between each reagent addition.
